smoke_inputs: Same original30 min/median/max N by CPU binding, tie key; all stages compare same sample, independent caches

formal.timing: Same frozen request boundaries; all method-specific setup/teardown included; no image preprocessing,H2D,verification or I/O
formal.interleave: Native,Original,Eligible optimized per input, rotating order and second-session offset

formal.drift: Record all >5% E2E/TPOT warnings, preserve slow samples, investigate; no rebaselining or selective retries
formal.scope: Only genuinely changed methods, corresponding originals and same-backbone Native; no standalone external methods

screen_selection.benefit: Any TTFT/TPOT/E2E improvement >=1%; E2E regression no more0.5%; among eligible useful stages retain lowest screening E2E for formal two-session validation; all ablations and negatives reported. No numerical selection or parameter search.
